faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NEHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NEHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 1 Research Assistant, 8 Field Investigator.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NEHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 2 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 37,000/Month (Fixed) for Research Assistant, Rs. 20,000/Month (Fixed) for Field Investigator.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Research Assistant: Post graduate in social science discipline (55% minimum) with NET /M.Phil. / Ph.D., with prior fieldwork and qualitative research experience. Field Investigator: Post graduate in social science discipline with minimum 55% marks and written and spoken knowledge of Khasi/ Assamese. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Research Assistant: proficiency in IT skills, including Microsoft Office and G-Suite applications. Research Assistant: able to handle large scale household data with STATA software. Research Assistant: excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Field Investigator: written and spoken knowledge of Khasi/ Assamese are mandatory.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting. Personal interview before the selection committee. List of shortlisted candidates will be uploaded on NEHU website by 04-12-2026. Shortlisted candidates appear before the selection committee for a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary from the date of joining. Research Assistant: 6 months, extendable based on review of performance. Field Investigator: 1 Months.

faq.question: Q9. Which places are covered by NEHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shillong (Research Assistant), Meghalaya (Field Investigator), Field Investigators travel to various locations of Assam and Meghalaya for fieldwork.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Detailed curriculum vitae (CV) with educational qualifications, NET, research degree/experience (if applicable); Names of two referees; Original copies of all testimonials at the interview.
